text.No pipeline em cascata, cada etapa cobra: In a cascaded pipeline, every stage takes its time, and transcription throws away everything that isn't a word — hurry, doubt, irritation. That's why these agents sound correct and still artificial: they respond to the text of what was said, not to how it was said. In speech↔speech mode there is no text stage in the middle — and that absence, more than any script, is what makes the conversation feel like a conversation.
